statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-10517 was rejected because it misattributes Clair server behavior to the claircore library. The optional PSK authentication and /indexer/api/v1/index_report endpoint described by the CVE are implemented in github.com/quay/clair, not github.com/quay/claircore. Kubescape CLI versions 3.0.48 and 4.0.11 import claircore only for its osrelease parser and do not contain or expose the affected Clair server API, so the vulnerable code is not present in this image.
